Hi Anjali —

Thanks again for the time to do a technical deep dive on Monday. We want to make sure there’s an executive sponsor present for the first 20 minutes to address roadmap/contract-level questions from your leadership. Can you confirm whether your CTO or VP Engineering will attend?

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue 19 Nov, 10:00–11:00
- Wed 20 Nov, 14:00–15:00

If neither works for your exec, we’ll bring our Chief Product Officer, Rishi Malhotra, to represent product/roadmap decisions and we can schedule a short follow-up with an executive if needed.

Attached: draft agenda and the deck we plan to walk through. If you prefer a different attendee list, tell us and we’ll adjust.

Next steps: please reply with the best window and which senior leader will join from your side.

Thanks —
Jordan
